# Stally

Stally helps you keep a collection of the things you choose, care for, and
spend time with, including places. Record everyday choices with Marks, or
simply look back on your time together.

## Your Collection

- Keep names, notes, photos, and choice history together.
- Add a start year, month, or exact day when you know it. Unknown dates can
  stay unset, and approximate dates keep their original precision.
- Include things that do not need daily Marks, such as a home or a plant.
  You can keep notes, photos or periods for them without adding Marks.
- Move items to Archive to hide them from Library. Their information is kept
  and elapsed time continues.

Stally is designed for iPhone and iPad running iOS 27.2 or later, with English
and Japanese app interfaces.

## Support

For help, questions, or feedback, open an issue in the
[Stally repository](https://github.com/muhiro12/Stally/issues).

Include your Stally version, iOS version, what you expected, and the steps that
led to the issue. GitHub Issues are public and require a GitHub account to post.
Do not attach collection backups, private photos, account details, or other
personal information. A short example using made-up items is usually enough.

## Common Questions

### Does Archive stop elapsed time?

No. Archive changes where an item appears. Its start and elapsed time continue
to describe the same item.

### Can I stop recording Marks?

Yes. Pausing prevents new Marks while preserving history. You can still
correct or delete existing Marks and resume recording later.

### Do I need a subscription for iCloud?

Yes. A subscription enables optional private iCloud sync. Turn on Use iCloud
in Settings, then relaunch Stally to apply the change. When iCloud
is available, Stally can synchronize your collection through your account.

### How should I keep a backup?

Export your data from Import & Export and keep the saved file in a location you
trust. Use a package with photos if you want to keep available image files;
they can contain embedded location information. Standalone JSON contains
records and captions only. During import you review changes before saving.
Records missing from a file are kept.
